data.title: Nokia’s (NOK) AI Network Bet Gets A Taiwan Proving Ground
data.description: Nokia (NYSE:NOK) has spent the past year rebuilding its story around AI, and earlier on July 14, it added another data point. The company signed a 5G expansion agreement with Taiwan Mobile to deploy its AirScale portfolio and AI-driven software across the carrier’s network, part of a broader push toward what Nokia calls AI-native mobile […]
